name: io.github.flow-steward/letta
title: Letta Agents
description: Create and message stateful Letta agents, delegate work, and retrieve their replies. Agents retain memory across conversations. This connection exposes agent delegation tools; direct memory CRUD and agent deletion are not documented MCP tools.

headers.description: Create a project API key in Letta Platform at platform.letta.com. Enter as: Bearer <LETTA_API_KEY>
